lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 请问，去火车站坐几路车？
lines.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, qù huǒchēzhàn zuò jǐ lù chē?
lines.en: Excuse me, which bus goes to the train station?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Take the number three, it's fast.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Bù yuǎn, shí fēnzhōng jiù dào.
lines.en: Not far, ten minutes and you're there.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Where do I buy a ticket?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 在车上买，给司机两块钱。
lines.pinyin: Zài chē shàng mǎi, gěi sījī liǎng kuài qián.
lines.en: On the bus. Give the driver two yuan.
